content.short: Infura is a leading all-in-one infrastructure provider for blockchain developers.
content.description: Infura provides reliable RPC nodes and a broad toolsuite for Web3 developers, enabling seamless data flow between applications and the blockchain. With a comprehensive set of APIs, tools, and infrastructure, Infura has helped projects like Uniswap, Compound, and Ethernity launch their apps. It supports networks such as Ethereum, Polygon, NEAR, and Avalanche, and is trusted by over 400,000 developers across DeFi, NFTs, and IPFS.
